_note: There is no ratified .well-known/mcp.json standard, so this file is minimal. helloai.com does not run an MCP server: the directory is a plain HTTP API described by OpenAPI. The HelloAI Marketplace at app.helloai.com has an MCP server, but it is per-account (tenant-scoped, behind a token) and has no public discovery URL yet, so no server is listed here. A server entry will be added when the app publishes one.
